requirements.text: The system should allow students to manage book loans online.
The system should allow students to book study rooms online.
Email reminders for due dates should be sent to students.
Renewing books should be simple, with an easy online process.
Rules regarding the number of renewals or holds on books should apply.
Fines for overdue books should be automatically calculated and displayed in the system.
Students should receive notifications when fines are incurred.
Librarians should have tools to track available books.
Librarians should be able to manage inventory updates.
Librarians should have the ability to generate reports on popular items.
